items.summary: Recommendation: preserve financial containment and reject monetization or spend expansion. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the aggregate row is not site-attributable. AI usage is $973.35 across 5,439 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, but conflicting retained cost records prevent ROI, margin, payback, and cost-to-learn calculations. Smallest next step: finish the existing period-aligned reconciliation.

Recommendation: preserve financial containment and continue only the existing period-aligned reconciliation. Authorize no discretionary spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or new production work. Supported revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate row cannot be assigned to sites; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage reports $973.3548129 across 5,439 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, conflicting with retained records of $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls through 2026-09-26 and $963.5690377 across 5,390 calls. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost windows are misaligned, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing costs are absent, incremental outcomes are not isolated, and no monthly budget limits are recorded. Do not treat clicks, impressions, sessions, conversions, SEO scores, or performance metrics as financial return. Smallest next step: complete the existing reconciliation using period-aligned revenue, AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and budget records where available; preserve unknowns and retain all growth opportunities as deferred backlog.

Continue only the existing financial reconciliation. Preserve the aggregate commission as unattributed and reconcile conflicting AI-cost records before any ROI, margin, payback, cost-to-learn, forecast, budget, or spend conclusion. Minimum measurements required for contribution margin are period-aligned attributable revenue, variable AI/infrastructure/domain/marketing costs, and any allocated labor cost; cost-to-learn additionally requires a defined incremental learning outcome and its attributable cost. Missing telemetry is unknown, not zero.
